IC1: history of significant bleeding (i.e. bleeding which required intervention [OR] or hospitalization), even in the absence of anticoagulation treatment at the time of the bleeding event, or
IC2: a cardioembolic event, which occurred on anticoagulation, or
IC3: a high risk profile of the patient, defined as a CHA2DS2-VASc score = 3 and a HAS-BLED score = 2
